chapters.label: Six minutes left, live
chapters.text: April two thousand and three, FA Cup semi-final. Arsenal lead Sheffield United one-nil, six minutes left. Asaba shoots, and Peschisolido heads it towards an open goal!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. David Seaman is over at his near post, so he springs backwards and flings his right hand.

chapters.label: Behind the ball
chapters.text: From behind the goal: his glove gets behind the ball on the line and scoops it away. Arsenal are through to the final!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Safe hands! Your turn: get your body behind the ball, so even if it slips, it will not go in.
